root_cause.text: The io_uring/rsrc subsystem does not reject zero-length fixed buffer imports, allowing an offset equal to the total registered buffer length during import, which causes the bvec skip logic to read beyond the allocated bio_vec array and access out-of-bounds slab memory.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that validate_fixed_range() uses strict greater-than (`buf_end > imu->ubuf + imu->len`), which permits a zero-length buffer at the exact end of the region. Consequently, io_import_fixed() computes `offset == imu->len`, and the bvec skip logic advances past the last valid bio_vec entry, causing the KASAN slab-out-of-bounds read shown in the bug report. The patch adds an early return in io_import_fixed() for zero-length imports.
